header:
Awesome Real Estate Tech

> Open-source tools for property data, listings, rental management, mapping, valuation models and investor analysis. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Data has terms.** Listing sites often forbid scraping.
- **Models are estimates.** Use a licensed appraiser for decisions.
- **Check local law** for tenant screening and fair housing.
- **Check the license.**

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
